sources.title: Monzo Help - Understanding fees for using your Monzo card abroad
Fee-free Debit & Credit Cards Made for Travel
Your Most-Asked Travel Money Questions, Answered

brands.evidence: You can pay anywhere in any currency with your Monzo card, fee-free.

client_claims.text: You can pay anywhere in any currency with your Monzo card, fee-free.
Monzo passes Mastercard's exchange rate on to you with no extra charges.
If Monzo is your main bank account, withdrawals are unlimited and fee-free in the EEA.
Outside the EEA you get £200 every 30 days, then a 3% fee.
If Monzo isn't your main bank: £400 fee-free per 30 days in UK & EEA, then 3%.
Monzo Plus gets unlimited fee-free in UK & EEA and £400 fee-free per 30 days outside EEA.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover the Plus plan; it is not among the current paid plans listed.

client_claims.text: Premium, Perks & Max get unlimited fee-free in UK & EEA and £600 fee-free per 30 days outside the EEA.
client_claims.note: Facts list the plans' prices but not their withdrawal allowances.

client_claims.text: Some ATMs charge their own fee, which Monzo doesn't receive.
Monzo defines main bank as having your salary paid into Monzo.
Monzo's own pages do not show a flat £2 fee per withdrawal.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover a £2 fee, though F7 describes a 3% fee after the allowance.
